title: Partners May Avoid Auction by Compensating Co-Owners
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: No Mandatory Auction When Separate Sale Is Viable
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that if Sara is able to sell her share for no less than its value had the entire property been sold as a whole, the partners cannot be compelled to sell at auction (مزاد). FAIL if the note does not state that the partners are free from compelled auction when Sara can obtain no less than the value her share would have if the whole property were sold together.

criteria.title: Partners' Right to Avoid Auction by Compensating
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the partners (Khalid and Omar) may avoid a sale at auction (مزاد) by paying the amount of the shortfall (النقص) that Sara's share suffers as a result of being sold separately. FAIL if the note does not state that Khalid and Omar can prevent the auction by compensating Sara for the exact shortfall caused by the separate sale of her share.

criteria.title: Court Orders Auction When Division Causes Major Loss
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the general principle is that the court orders a sale at auction (مزاد) when physical division (قسمة عينية) results in a major loss (نقص كبير) in value. FAIL if the note does not state that the court's order for auction is the general principle triggered specifically by a major loss in value resulting from physical division.
